meta.slot_rule: 2/2/2 split of the 6-verb exp51 inventory drawn at seed 85999; event i draws from slot i (1-indexed); disjointness ensures the verb-indexed query is well-posed (doc 55 §4.2) and costs any claim about discourse-position resolution (doc 55 §11).
meta.split_unit: CAST -- a (bearer, non-bearer) pairing; SHARED across all T, so the T=1/T=2/T=3 control compares like with like.
meta.heldout_is: UNSEEN PAIRINGS (same rule as exp69, doc 55 §4.5).
meta.schedule_rule: T=2: verb pair by stride 5 mod 4; surface-order pair by stride 3 mod 4. T=3: verb triple by stride 5 mod 8; surface-order triple by stride 3 mod 8; qpat [1,1,2,2,3,3] per-cast shuffle gives 2 items per query index. T=1: verb alternates V1[j%2] (3 each per cast). All strides coprime to their moduli.
